title: 一センチ
subject: a fifty-two-year-old man at his company health check who is told he has shrunk one centimetre since last year, measures himself twice more, and walks back to the office through the station with his chin up as if he can stretch it back
caption: Japanese AOR yacht rock in the late-70s Tokyo light-mellow style. Clean chorus-laden electric guitar playing jazzy ninth chords, Fender Rhodes, smooth fretless-tone bass, soft tenor saxophone fills, relaxed drums with rimshots. Polished late-70s studio sheen, wide stereo, gentle tape warmth. Male mellow tenor, relaxed crooning with stacked harmonies on the chorus. 98 BPM, B-flat major. Smooth, wry and gently uplifting. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM synths, no distorted guitars, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes, chorus guitar, soft sax]

[Verse 1]
健康診断 身長計
かかとをつけて 背を伸ばす
「去年より 一センチ」
看護師さんが さらっと言う

[Pre-Chorus]
もう一度だけ 測らせて
二回目も やっぱり同じ

[Chorus]
一センチ どこへ行った
五十二の 春の朝
一センチ 取り戻しに
あごを上げて 歩くよ

[Verse 2]
駅の階段 背筋を張る
ガラスに映る 少し変な人
若い頃より 前を見てる
それも悪くは ないけれど

[Bridge - sax solo]
縮んだ分 空が近い
そういうことに しておこう

[Chorus]
一センチ どこへ行った
会社の前で 立ち止まる
一センチ 取り戻した
気がした 今日だけは

[Outro - Rhodes, guitar fades]
来年また 測るまで
この背筋で いようか
